author: mark
text:
provider: Anthropic Messages API client (blocking, non-streaming)

One Client::send call realizes one model call as one HTTP API call
against POST {endpoint}/v1/messages, per ARCH §2.1 / §4.1.

Blocking reqwest over async for v0.1 (no concurrency yet; revisit at
v0.4). Error taxonomy: Config / Network / Auth (401,403) / RateLimit
(429) / Provider (other non-2xx) / Parse. Auth reads the env var named
in providers.yaml Provider.auth and sends as x-api-key; anthropic-version
fixed at 2023-06-01.

Response.stop_reason kept as raw wire string: one of Anthropic's values
uses a banned-term spelling (ARCH §2.1), harness does not branch on it
yet. ContentBlock uses serde(other) so new provider-side block types
do not fail parsing.

15 integration tests drive the client against httpmock covering the full
error taxonomy plus serde round-trips and env-var resolution. No live
API calls. 100% line coverage retained. Gates closed: bl-9a09, bl-d12c,
bl-0b1c.
